$comment: Source of truth for the Eidolon issue label taxonomy. Apply with `pnpm labels:sync`, check for drift with `pnpm labels:check`. Documented in docs/delivery/labels.md. Prefixed names mirror the Linear EID team so an issue means the same thing in both systems.

labels.name: type/bug
labels.description: Behaviour is wrong relative to a documented or intended contract

labels.name: type/feature
labels.description: New user- or operator-visible capability

labels.name: type/improvement
labels.description: Existing capability made better without changing its contract

labels.name: type/chore
labels.description: Maintenance with no behaviour change: dependencies, cleanup, tooling

labels.name: type/docs
labels.description: Documentation, runbooks, or agent instructions

labels.name: type/security
labels.description: Security or privacy control, hardening, or vulnerability fix

labels.name: type/test
labels.description: Test coverage, test infrastructure, or test reliability

labels.name: area/server
labels.description: server/ — Express API, services, middleware

labels.name: area/ui
labels.description: ui/ — React web application

labels.name: area/desktop
labels.description: packages/desktop — Electron shell and local runtime companion

labels.name: area/mcp
labels.description: packages/mcp-server and MCP client integration

labels.name: area/db
labels.description: packages/db — schema, Drizzle migrations, query performance

labels.name: area/ci
labels.description: GitHub Actions, lint, formatting, dead-code, and release automation

labels.name: area/docs
labels.description: docs/, README, AGENTS.md

labels.name: area/observability
labels.description: Health, metrics, tracing, logging, alerting, profiling

labels.name: area/security
labels.description: Authentication, authorisation, secrets, privacy, scanning

labels.name: area/delivery
labels.description: Backlog hygiene, labels, feature flags, rollout, dependency management

labels.name: priority/urgent
labels.description: Active harm or legal exposure. Work starts now (Linear priority 1)

labels.name: priority/high
labels.description: Blocks a committed outcome or leaves a known gap open (Linear priority 2)

labels.name: priority/medium
labels.description: Clear value, no deadline pressure (Linear priority 3)

labels.name: priority/low
labels.description: Worth doing when convenient (Linear priority 4)

labels.name: stale
labels.description: No activity for 60 days; applied by the issue-hygiene workflow

labels.name: sentry
labels.description: Created from Sentry error tracking

labels.name: pinned
labels.description: Exempt from stale marking

labels.name: duplicate
labels.description: Already tracked by another issue
